authorities.name: Re Ellenborough Park
authorities.citation_note: Neutral citation (likely [1955] EWCA Civ 4) not independently re-confirmed this session - BAILII blocked. The Law Report citation [1956] Ch 131 comes from a live fetch of the citing judgment below.
authorities.date_note: Year only confirmed via the citing judgment; exact date not independently verified this session.
authorities.proposition: The four requirements of a valid easement: (i) there must be a dominant and a servient tenement; (ii) the right must accommodate the dominant tenement; (iii) the dominant and servient owners must be different persons; (iv) the right must be capable of forming the subject-matter of a grant.
authorities.verification_note: Not read directly - BAILII blocked (HTTP 403), block treated as final. Quoted verbatim within Regency Villas Title Ltd v Diamond Resorts (Europe) Ltd [2017] EWCA Civ 238 (below), fetched live.

authorities.name: Regency Villas Title Ltd v Diamond Resorts (Europe) Ltd
authorities.date_note: Year only confirmed; exact date not independently verified this session.
authorities.proposition: Quotes Ellenborough Park's four-requirement test verbatim at para 12 and actively applies and extends it to recreational easements at para 56, treating it as good law sixty-two years on.

edges.verified_via: Regency Villas Title Ltd v Diamond Resorts (Europe) Ltd [2017] EWCA Civ 238, fetched directly from Find Case Law: applies the Ellenborough Park test and extends it to recreational easements.

what_this_is_not: One verified node-pair confirming the Ellenborough Park test remains good law as of 2017. Does not independently confirm Ellenborough Park's original 1955 text or neutral citation - see verification_note and citation_note above. The subsequent Supreme Court decision in the SAME case, Regency Villas Title Ltd v Diamond Resorts (Europe) Ltd [2018] UKSC 57, could not be fetched this session (attempted URL returned 404) and is NOT included here - its existence and outcome are known only from secondary search corroboration, which does not meet this repo's verification bar.
